Deze juridische teksten worden in het Engels verstrekt. Een vertaling wordt alleen ter informatie aangeboden; bij verschillen geldt de Engelse versie.

We collect the following categories of personal and business data to provide our services:

• Business information: Company name, registration numbers (KvK, Handelsregister), VAT number, trade certifications, business address
• Account data: Name, email address, phone number, language preference
• Job data: Job descriptions, schedules, addresses, materials used, time tracking records, completion status
• Financial records: Invoices, quotes, payment records, pricing data, accounting exports
• Photos: Job site photos uploaded for AI analysis, receipt/invoice scans
• Location: Job site addresses for scheduling and route optimization (not real-time GPS tracking)
• Usage analytics: Anonymized feature usage to improve the platform

• Core platform functionality: Job management, scheduling, invoicing, quoting
• AI-powered insights: Our compound AI engine analyzes your business data to generate actionable recommendations, predict payment timelines, optimize pricing, and identify workflow improvements
• Payment processing: Processing payments via Mollie (EU) or Stripe (UK) when you create payment links
• Accounting sync: Exporting invoices and financial data to your connected accounting provider (only when you explicitly connect and trigger exports)
• Benchmarking: Anonymized, aggregated cross-contractor benchmarks to help you understand market positioning (no individual data is ever shared)

We only share your data with third parties when necessary to provide our services:

• Payment providers: Mollie (EU countries) and Stripe (UK) for payment processing — only invoice amounts and customer details required for payment
• Accounting providers: Your connected accounting software (Moneybird, DATEV, Lexoffice, SevDesk, Pennylane, Holded, Fatture in Cloud, Xero, QuickBooks, etc.) — only when you explicitly trigger an export
• Cloud infrastructure: Supabase (EU-hosted) for secure data storage and authentication
• AI processing: Anthropic (Claude) for photo analysis — images are processed and not retained

We never sell your data to third parties. We never share individual business data with competitors.

Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights — all implemented directly in the app:

• Right of access: View all your data in the app at any time
• Right to data portability: Export all your data (jobs, invoices, quotes, customers) as structured data using the "Export my data" button below
• Right to erasure: Delete your account and all associated data using the "Delete my account" button below. Financial records subject to legal retention periods will be anonymized rather than deleted.
• Right to rectification: Edit any of your data directly in the app
• Right to restrict processing: Contact us at privacy@vascobuild.com
• Right to object: Opt out of analytics in your profile settings

• Financial records (invoices, quotes, payments): 7 years minimum, as required by EU tax law (Belastingdienst NL, Finanzamt DE, HMRC UK, etc.)
• Contract and job records: 7 years from completion
• Customer data: Retained while your account is active, deleted within 30 days of account closure (except where linked to retained financial records)
• Usage analytics: Anonymized and aggregated after 12 months
• Photos and scans: Retained while your account is active, deleted within 30 days of account closure
